title: 법원조사관 등 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:02507:20131210:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum to the Rules on Court Public Officials <Supreme Court Rule No. 2507, December 10, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on December 12, 2013. [Proviso omitted.]

Articles 2 through 7
Omitted.

Article 8 (Amendment of Other Rules)
(1) through (3) Omitted.
(4) Part of the Rules on Court Investigation Officers, etc. shall be amended as follows:
In the main sentence of Article 2 (2), "contractual public officials" shall be replaced with "fixed-term public officials".
(5) through (8) Omitted.
